hooks.command: bash -c 'p=hooks/dispatch.sh; for r in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "$PWD" "$PWD/.."; do [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/$p" ] && exec bash "$r/$p" pre-write; done; echo "[saas-startup-team] critical hook target not found: $p" >&2; exit 2'
hooks.description: Path-scoped pre-write gates: PII/secrets, JSON schema, ad spend (fail closed); LinkedIn advisory

hooks.command: bash -c 'p=hooks/dispatch.sh; for r in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "$PWD" "$PWD/.."; do [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/$p" ] && exec bash "$r/$p" pre-bash; done; echo "[saas-startup-team] critical hook target not found: $p" >&2; exit 2'
hooks.description: Block incident-linked gh pr merge without a regression test (or override)

hooks.command: bash -c 'p=hooks/dispatch.sh; for r in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "$PWD" "$PWD/.."; do [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/$p" ] && exec bash "$r/$p" post-write; done; cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo "[saas-startup-team] hook target not found: $p" >&2; exit 0'

hooks.command: bash -c 'p=scripts/ensure-engineering-principles.sh; for r in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "$PWD" "$PWD/.."; do [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/$p" ] && exec bash "$r/$p" --root "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; done; echo "[saas-startup-team] hook target not found: $p" >&2; exit 0'
hooks.description: Ensure KISS/YAGNI/DRY engineering principles in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md
